Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Hakuron wrote:
> I see your point.
>
> Nevertheless, a fully built-up ally deck with the methuselah at more than 10 pool can get blown away by a single Anarchist Uprising. Is that "fair"?
>
> I think that this game needs some cards with a drastic effect. Everybody is free to play them. Or do you think, that "Temptation of Greater Power" hinders variety of decks?
>
I don't like the word "fair", I prefer to talk about game balance.
Anarchist Uprising is a silver bullet against certain decks. Most of the time though, it will result in an average pool loss of 3.

ToGP is a silver bullet against any kind of deck (well, except Imbueds -- but they are immune to so many cards anyway) and results in the oust of the player in the same turn or the turn after in 90% of the cases. At least, that's what I observe everytime I see the card played, that's why I write down a game report each time to keep track of this.

Plus, it's a "one-per-game" card so, like Giant's Blood, the first Methuselah that can play it has a huge advantage.

Clearly, I consider the card to be broken.
